title: Compatible coefficient-field presentations for a flat local map with regular closed fibre
statement:
Let $f:(A,\mathfrak m,K)\to(B,\mathfrak n,L)$ be a flat local homomorphism of nonzero commutative Noetherian local $\mathbf Q$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; local means $f(\mathfrak m)\subseteq\mathfrak n$, and $K=A/\mathfrak m$, $L=B/\mathfrak n$. Assume that $B/\mathfrak mB$ is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme] of finite Krull dimension $s$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Write $\widehat A=\varprojlim_d A/\mathfrak m^d$, $\widehat B=\varprojlim_d B/\mathfrak n^d$ and $\widehat f:\widehat A\to\widehat B$ for the induced map [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. There are field sections $a:K\to\widehat A$ and $b:L\to\widehat B$ of the residue maps satisfying $b|_K=\widehat f\,a$ for the induced inclusion $K\to L$, an integer $e\geq0$, an ideal $I\subseteq(X_1,\ldots,X_e)$ of $K[[X_1,\ldots,X_e]]$, and isomorphisms of complete local algebras
$$\widehat A\simeq K[[X_1,\ldots,X_e]]/I,\qquad
\widehat B\simeq L[[X_1,\ldots,X_e,T_1,\ldots,T_s]]/I L[[X_1,\ldots,X_e,T_1,\ldots,T_s]],$$
where power series are [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], the coefficients on the right use the induced inclusion $K\to L$, the first isomorphism is $K$-linear for the $K$-algebra structure of $\widehat A$ given by $a$ and the second is $L$-linear for the $L$-algebra structure of $\widehat B$ given by $b$ (so both induce the identity on residue fields), and these isomorphisms identify $\widehat f$ with coefficient extension and the inclusion of the $X$ variables. The images of $T_1,\ldots,T_s$ form a regular system of parameters of $\widehat B/\mathfrak m\widehat B$: their classes generate its maximal ideal and their number equals its dimension. No finite type hypothesis is imposed on $A$, $B$, or the residue-field extension.

These tags are inputs, not a claim that either states this coefficient-compatible normal form verbatim.

proof.text: Put $A_0=\widehat A$, $B_0=\widehat B$, and $f_0=\widehat f$. The completion results give Noetherian local rings with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_0=\mathfrak m A_0$ and $\mathfrak n_0=\mathfrak n B_0$, residue fields canonically $K,L$, and completeness for these maximal ideals. The induced map is local: its reduction is the induced field inclusion $K\hookrightarrow L$, so an element of $\mathfrak m_0$ has zero image residue and maps into $\mathfrak n_0$. By flatness under completion, $f_0$ is flat. The canonical maps preserve the $\mathbf Q$-algebra structures.

Let $C=B/\mathfrak mB$ with maximal ideal the image of $\mathfrak n$. Since $f$ is local, $\mathfrak mB\subseteq\mathfrak n$, so $C$ is nonzero Noetherian local. Completion of the surjection $B\to C$ gives $B_0/(\mathfrak mB)B_0\simeq\widehat C$. Since $\mathfrak m_0=\mathfrak m A_0$ and $f_0$ commutes with the canonical maps, $(\mathfrak mB)B_0=\mathfrak m_0B_0$. Write $C_0=B_0/\mathfrak m_0B_0$. Its identification with $\widehat C$ preserves residue fields and quotient maps. Completion preserves regularity and dimension, so $C_0$ is complete regular local of dimension $s$, with residue field $L$.

Apply [lem-trf-compatible-coefficient-source-presentation] to $f_0:A_0\to B_0$. Obtain compatible sections $a,b$, generators $x_i$, the local surjection $q:R=K[[X]]\twoheadrightarrow A_0$, and $I=\ker q\subseteq\mathfrak r=(X)R$. Its quotient isomorphism is $K$-linear.

source.place: Agent-formulated compatible-section and source-presentation input: Tag 032A (theorem-cohen-structure-theorem), characteristic-zero coefficient-field construction and final proof paragraph; more-algebra.tex Tag 07NJ (lemma-lift-continuous) applied to the unrestricted residue extension. Extracted from original steps 3--4 of lem-trf-relative-cohen-flat-presentation; compatibility is a refinement, not quoted verbatim from 032A.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-relative-power-series-fibre-diagram] to these data and the complete regular fibre $C_0$ of dimension $s$. It gives lifts $t_i$, the coefficient-preserving isomorphism $\rho:L[[T]]\simeq C_0$, the Noetherian complete local ring $S=L[[X,T]]$, local $j:R\to S$, and surjective $v:S\to B_0$, with $vj=f_0q$ and $\pi v=\rho p$, where $p$ sets $X=0$ and $\ker p=\mathfrak rS$. For $z\in\ker v$, $\rho(p(z))=0$; injectivity of $\rho$ gives $z\in\mathfrak rS$. The residues of the $t_i=v(T_i)$ generate the maximal ideal of $C_0$.

source.place: Agent-formulated coefficient-preserving presentation diagram: Tag 07NQ (proposition-fs-flat-fibre-fs), proof of (2) implies (3), special-fibre diagram before the kernel identity; algebra.tex Tag 0C0S (lemma-regular-complete-containing-coefficient-field), clause (2) and proof. Extracted from original steps 5--7 of lem-trf-relative-cohen-flat-presentation; explicit evaluation and setting-X-to-zero identities are the refinement.

proof.text: Apply flat closed-fibre kernel rigidity with presentation $q:R\twoheadrightarrow A_0$, flat map $f_0:A_0\to B_0$, local map $j:R\to S$ and surjection $v:S\twoheadrightarrow B_0$. Here $R,A_0,S$ are local, $S$ is Noetherian, $vj=f_0q$, and $\ker v\subseteq\mathfrak rS$ by step 4. It yields $\ker v=(\ker q)S=IS$. The quotient isomorphism $S/IS\simeq B_0$ is $L$-linear for $b$, and the one for $R/I\simeq A_0$ is $K$-linear for $a$. The equation $vj=f_0q$ identifies the induced map with coefficient extension and inclusion of the $X$ variables. A ring isomorphism preserves units, hence maximal ideals and their powers; both quotient maps are therefore homeomorphisms for the maximal-ideal-adic topologies. Modulo $\mathfrak m_0B_0$, the images of $T_i$ are the chosen $\bar t_i$, which generate the maximal ideal and number $s=\dim C_0$. This proves every asserted compatibility.
